$comment: Source of truth for the skill catalog. Every skill lists the "foundation" bundle (shared Build vocabulary and answer rules; scripts/validate.py enforces it). scripts/sync_shared.py copies each skill's shared files (knowledge/, shared/, examples/ and the company/ rule book) into the skill folder, and scripts/validate.py checks that SKILL.md files match this list. Add your own skills here.

skills.name: ask-rulebook
skills.summary: How do we do things here? Answers from the company rule book, with sources, gaps and stale files flagged.

skills.name: build-coach
skills.summary: Advice from the Build book and framework, fitted to the company's goals, principles, culture and past decisions.

skills.name: build-scorecard
skills.summary: Baseline the organization across the Build framework's nine metric groups, from data or a structured self-assessment.

skills.name: company-context
skills.summary: Set up, extend and audit the company rule book: goals, metrics, principles, culture, career framework, surveys, decisions.

skills.name: pull-teams
skills.summary: Pull the team structure from Swarmia into company/teams/, keeping local missions, ownership and attributes.

skills.name: push-teams
skills.summary: Push the reviewed team structure from company/teams/ to Swarmia, previewed and confirmed before anything changes.
